title.title: Dynamic Drone Fail-Safe
title.subtitle: Where should a failing drone land?

lines: A drone inspects a power line at night.
A repair crew works on the access road and a tower pad.
A fail-safe takes over as 3 faults strike:

part1Card.label: Tutorial part 1
part1Card.heading: The textbook fail-safe
part1Card.line: It follows the defaults that drone autopilots document today. Watch it face the 3 faults.

textbookLog.text: GPS loss confirmed → rule says hold for the pilot
The night wind pushes the drone downhill
Link loss confirmed → rule says land; drone descends

issue.heading: A static rule
lines: Each fault triggers a fixed action, whatever lies below.
So the drone can come down in a creek, on steep grass or beside people.

part2Card.label: Tutorial part 4
part2Card.heading: The dynamic fail-safe
lines: DeepCausality's Effect Ethos makes the fail-safe dynamic.
It checks each landing site against rules from published pilot procedures and the context the drone senses every second.

ethosLog.text: GPS loss confirmed → drone steers by camera and LiDAR
Effect Ethos forbids landing beside the crew
ethosLog.rule: rule: keep 13 m clear of people

ethosLog.text: Effect Ethos permits the middle of the terrace
Link loss confirmed → drone waits over the terrace
Recovery window closes → drone lands on the terrace
ethosLog.rule: contingency: land as soon as practicable

ethosLog.text: Cell fails → Effect Ethos confirms the terrace
ethosLog.rule: emergency: land as soon as possible

ethosLog.text: Drone lands upright, 34 m from the crew

simulations.heading: The tutorial simulated this scenario 1,000 different ways
simulations.description: Each simulation changed the launch time, wind, faults, terrain and where up to 8 people stood. Both fail-safes flew all 1,000.
simulations.countLabelOne: unsafe landing within 10 m of a person
simulations.countLabelMany: unsafe landings within 10 m of a person

summary.heading: How DeepCausality builds the dynamic fail-safe

steps.name: Dynamic context
steps.text: A thermal camera and LiDAR update a context of the ground every second.

steps.name: Dynamic reasoning
steps.text: Every second, a causal process confirms each fault and declares contingency or emergency.

steps.name: Dynamic Effect Ethos
steps.text: Rules from published pilot procedures check each landing site against the context, people first.

end.line: Build the dynamic fail-safe in Rust, step by step.
